_meta.source: Crystal Warden AI governance control set, structured on the NIST AI RMF functions (Govern/Map/Measure/Manage). Encodes the organizational AI-governance questions (inventory, approval, data, vendors, decision impact, human review, high-risk controls, exceptions, incidents, evidence retention, leadership visibility). Crosswalk to NIST AI RMF 1.0 subcategories and ISO/IEC 42001 is pending an authoritative source table.

MP-1.title: AI use and process inventory
MP-1.control: The organization maintains a current inventory of who uses AI and which business processes use it.

objectives.text: An inventory of AI users and roles is maintained.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that an inventory of AI users and roles is maintained.

objectives.text: An inventory of AI-enabled business processes is maintained.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that an inventory of AI-enabled business processes is maintained.

objectives.text: The AI inventory is reviewed and updated on a defined cadence.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the AI inventory is reviewed and updated on a defined cadence.

MP-2.title: Approved AI tools
MP-2.control: The organization defines which AI tools are approved and controls the use of unapproved tools.

objectives.text: An approved-AI-tools list is defined and maintained.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that an approved-AI-tools list is defined and maintained.

objectives.text: Use of unapproved AI tools is prohibited and monitored.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that use of unapproved AI tools is prohibited and monitored.

MP-3.title: AI data governance
MP-3.control: The organization governs what data is entered into AI systems and controls prohibited data.

objectives.text: The data entered into AI systems is inventoried.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the data entered into AI systems is inventoried.

objectives.text: A policy defines what data may and may not be entered into AI systems.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that a policy defines what data may and may not be entered into AI systems.

objectives.text: Controls prevent prohibited data such as CUI or PII from entering AI systems.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that controls prevent prohibited data such as CUI or PII from entering AI systems.

MP-4.title: Embedded and vendor AI inventory
MP-4.control: The organization inventories vendors and products that provide embedded AI capabilities.

objectives.text: An inventory of vendor-provided and embedded AI is maintained.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that an inventory of vendor-provided and embedded AI is maintained.

objectives.text: Vendor AI is reviewed for risk on a defined cadence.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that vendor AI is reviewed for risk on a defined cadence.

MP-5.title: Decision-impact classification
MP-5.control: The organization classifies each AI use by whether its outputs influence decisions and tiers risk accordingly.

objectives.text: Each AI use records whether its outputs influence decisions.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that each AI use records whether its outputs influence decisions.

objectives.text: AI uses are assigned a risk tier based on decision impact.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that AI uses are assigned a risk tier based on decision impact.

GV-1.title: Human review of AI outputs
GV-1.control: The organization defines when human review of AI outputs is required and retains evidence of it.

objectives.text: A policy defines when human review of AI outputs is required, by risk tier.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that a policy defines when human review of AI outputs is required, by risk tier.

objectives.text: High-risk AI uses require documented human review before the output is acted on.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that high-risk AI uses require documented human review before the output is acted on.

objectives.text: Evidence of human review is retained.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that evidence of human review is retained.

GV-2.title: AI exception approval
GV-2.control: AI policy exceptions are approved through a defined process and recorded as signed decisions.

objectives.text: An AI exception and waiver process is defined.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that an AI exception and waiver process is defined.

objectives.text: Exceptions are approved by an accountable owner.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that exceptions are approved by an accountable owner.

objectives.text: Exception decisions are recorded as signed, dated records and retained.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that exception decisions are recorded as signed, dated records and retained.

GV-3.title: Leadership AI risk visibility
GV-3.control: Leadership receives periodic reporting on AI risk.

objectives.text: An AI risk report is produced on a defined cadence.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that an AI risk report is produced on a defined cadence.

objectives.text: The AI risk report is delivered to accountable leadership.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the AI risk report is delivered to accountable leadership.

MG-1.title: Controls for high-risk AI
MG-1.control: High-risk AI uses have defined additional controls.

objectives.text: Criteria for high-risk AI use are defined.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that criteria for high-risk AI use are defined.

objectives.text: Additional controls are applied to high-risk AI uses.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that additional controls are applied to high-risk AI uses.

MG-2.title: AI incident escalation
MG-2.control: AI incidents are detected, escalated, and handled through a defined process.

objectives.text: An AI incident-response and escalation process is defined.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that an AI incident-response and escalation process is defined.

objectives.text: AI incidents are escalated through the defined path.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that AI incidents are escalated through the defined path.

objectives.text: AI incident records are retained.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that AI incident records are retained.

MS-1.title: AI evidence retention
MS-1.control: AI-related evidence is retained for a defined period with its integrity protected.

objectives.text: A retention policy defines what AI evidence is kept and for how long.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that a retention policy defines what AI evidence is kept and for how long.

objectives.text: AI evidence is retained for the defined period.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that AI evidence is retained for the defined period.

objectives.text: The integrity and authenticity of retained AI evidence is protected by signing or timestamping.
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence that the integrity and authenticity of retained AI evidence is protected by signing or timestamping.
